import unittest
from typing import Any
from uuid import UUID, uuid4
from unittest.mock import AsyncMock, Mock

from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncConnection
from sqlalchemy.sql.elements import TextClause
from app.chat.repositories import Repository


class RepositoryTests(unittest.IsolatedAsyncioTestCase):
    def setUp(self) -> None:
        self.repository = Repository("unit-scope", 71)
        self.connection = Mock(spec=AsyncConnection)
        self.connection.execute = AsyncMock()
        self.connection.scalar = AsyncMock(return_value=3)
        self.inbox: dict[str, Any] = {
            "id": uuid4(), "identity_id": uuid4(), "chat_id": 7, "update_id": 81
        }

    def result(self, row: dict[str, Any] | None) -> Mock:
        result = Mock()
        result.mappings.return_value.first.return_value = row
        return result

    def captured(self, index: int) -> tuple[str, dict[str, Any]]:
        statement, parameters = self.connection.execute.await_args_list[index].args
        self.assertIsInstance(statement, TextClause)
        self.assertEqual(parameters["scope"], "unit-scope")
        self.assertEqual(parameters["bot"], 71)
        return " ".join(str(statement).split()), parameters

    async def test_identity_upsert_retains_returned_identity_and_refreshes_profile(self) -> None:
        identity = uuid4()
        for username, name in (("old", "Old"), ("new", "New")):
            self.connection.execute.side_effect = [self.result({"id": identity}), self.result(None)]
            await self.repository.intake(self.connection, 7, username, name, None, name, 81, 7, 21, "TEXT", "hello")
        for index, username, name in ((0, "old", "Old"), (2, "new", "New")):
            sql, parameters = self.captured(index)
            self.assertIn("ON CONFLICT (scope, bot_id, telegram_user_id) DO UPDATE", sql)
            for assignment in ("username=EXCLUDED.username", "display_name=EXCLUDED.display_name",
                               "first_name=EXCLUDED.first_name", "last_name=EXCLUDED.last_name"):
                self.assertIn(assignment, sql)
            self.assertEqual((parameters["username"], parameters["display"]), (username, name))
            inbox_sql, inbox_parameters = self.captured(index + 1)
            self.assertEqual(inbox_parameters["identity"], identity)
            self.assertIn("ON CONFLICT (scope, bot_id, update_id) DO NOTHING", inbox_sql)
            self.assertEqual((inbox_parameters["update"], inbox_parameters["chat"], inbox_parameters["message"]), (81, 7, 21))

    async def test_missing_identity_stops_before_inbox_insert(self) -> None:
        self.connection.execute.return_value = self.result(None)
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(RuntimeError, "^IDENTITY_NOT_RETURNED$"):
            await self.repository.intake(self.connection, 7, None, "Name", None, "Name", 81, 7, 21, "TEXT", "hello")
        self.assertEqual(self.connection.execute.await_count, 1)

    async def test_active_session_reuse_and_scoped_new_reset(self) -> None:
        session = {"id": uuid4()}
        self.connection.execute.return_value = self.result(session)
        self.assertEqual(await self.repository.session(self.connection, self.inbox), session)
        self.assertEqual(self.connection.execute.await_count, 1)
        sql, parameters = self.captured(0)
        self.assertIn("status='ACTIVE'", sql)
        self.assertEqual((parameters["identity"], parameters["chat"]), (self.inbox["identity_id"], 7))
        self.connection.execute.reset_mock()
        self.connection.execute.side_effect = [self.result(None), self.result(None), self.result(session)]
        self.assertEqual(await self.repository.session(self.connection, self.inbox, reset=True), session)
        reset_sql, reset_parameters = self.captured(0)
        self.assertIn("SET status='CLOSED'", reset_sql)
        self.assertIn("scope=:scope AND bot_id=:bot AND identity_id=:identity", reset_sql)
        self.assertIn("chat_id=:chat AND status='ACTIVE'", reset_sql)
        self.assertEqual(reset_parameters["identity"], self.inbox["identity_id"])
        insert_sql, insert_parameters = self.captured(2)
        self.assertIn("INSERT INTO conversation_sessions", insert_sql)
        self.assertIsInstance(insert_parameters["id"], UUID)

    async def test_sequence_scope_mismatch_never_inserts_message(self) -> None:
        session = uuid4()
        self.connection.scalar.return_value = None
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(RuntimeError, "^SESSION_SCOPE_MISMATCH$"):
            await self.repository.message(self.connection, self.inbox, session, "USER", "hello")
        self.connection.execute.assert_not_awaited()
        statement, parameters = self.connection.scalar.await_args.args
        self.assertIsInstance(statement, TextClause)
        sql = " ".join(str(statement).split())
        self.assertIn("id=:session AND identity_id=:identity", sql)
        self.assertIn("chat_id=:chat RETURNING last_sequence", sql)
        self.assertEqual(parameters, {"scope": "unit-scope", "bot": 71, "session": session,
                                     "identity": self.inbox["identity_id"], "chat": 7})

    async def test_reply_and_outbox_preserve_scope_and_order(self) -> None:
        session, user = uuid4(), uuid4()
        assistant = await self.repository.message(self.connection, self.inbox, session, "ASSISTANT", "answer",
                                                   reply_to=user, model="model", response_id="provider-id")
        sql, parameters = self.captured(0)
        self.assertIsInstance(assistant, UUID)
        self.assertEqual(parameters["id"], assistant)
        self.assertEqual((parameters["sequence"], parameters["reply"], parameters["model"], parameters["response"]),
                         (3, user, "model", "provider-id"))
        await self.repository.outbox(self.connection, self.inbox, session, "AI", ["first", "second"], assistant)
        for index, number, content in ((1, 0, "first"), (2, 1, "second")):
            sql, parameters = self.captured(index)
            self.assertIn("ON CONFLICT (scope, bot_id, inbox_id, response_kind, chunk_number) DO NOTHING", sql)
            self.assertEqual((parameters["identity"], parameters["chat"], parameters["session"], parameters["inbox"]),
                             (self.inbox["identity_id"], 7, session, self.inbox["id"]))
            self.assertEqual((parameters["assistant"], parameters["number"], parameters["content"]),
                             (assistant, number, content))

import asyncio
import unittest
from collections.abc import AsyncIterator
from contextlib import asynccontextmanager
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
from types import SimpleNamespace
from typing import Any
from uuid import uuid4
from unittest.mock import AsyncMock, Mock, patch

from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncConnection
from sqlalchemy.sql.elements import TextClause
import app.chat.worker as worker_module
from app.ai.openrouter import AIError, Completion, OpenRouterClient
from app.channels.telegram.sender import Delivery, Sender
from app.chat.repositories import Repository
from app.chat.worker import Worker
from app.core.database import Database


class TransactionMarkers:
    def __init__(self, connection: Mock) -> None:
        self.connection = connection
        self.active = False
        self.number = 0
        self.events: list[tuple[str, int]] = []

    @asynccontextmanager
    async def transaction(self) -> AsyncIterator[Mock]:
        if self.active:
            raise AssertionError("Nested transaction")
        self.number += 1
        number = self.number
        self.active = True
        self.events.append(("begin", number))
        try:
            yield self.connection
        except BaseException:
            self.events.append(("rollback", number))
            raise
        else:
            self.events.append(("commit", number))
        finally:
            self.active = False


class ConversationTests(unittest.IsolatedAsyncioTestCase):
    def setUp(self) -> None:
        self.connection = Mock(spec=AsyncConnection)
        self.connection.execute = AsyncMock()
        self.boundary = TransactionMarkers(self.connection)
        self.database = Mock(spec=Database)
        self.database.transaction = Mock(side_effect=self.boundary.transaction)
        self.repository = Mock(spec=Repository)
        self.repository.parameters.side_effect = self.parameters
        self.repository.one = AsyncMock()
        self.repository.session = AsyncMock()
        self.repository.message = AsyncMock()
        self.repository.outbox = AsyncMock(side_effect=self.capture_outbox)
        self.repository.execute = AsyncMock(side_effect=self.capture_execute)
        self.ai = Mock(spec=OpenRouterClient)
        self.ai.reply = AsyncMock(side_effect=self.complete)
        self.sender = Mock(spec=Sender)
        self.sender.send = AsyncMock(side_effect=self.send)
        self.worker = Worker(self.database, self.repository, self.ai, self.sender)
        self.session_id, self.user_id, self.assistant_id = uuid4(), uuid4(), uuid4()
        self.inbox: dict[str, Any] = {"id": uuid4(), "identity_id": uuid4(), "chat_id": 7,
            "update_id": 81, "session_id": None, "kind": "TEXT", "content": "current",
            "attempts": 0, "status": "PENDING", "next_attempt_at": None}
        self.identity = {"display_name": "Name", "username": "handle"}
        self.writes: list[tuple[str, dict[str, Any], int]] = []
        self.outboxes: list[tuple[tuple[Any, ...], int]] = []
        self.repository.session.return_value = {"id": self.session_id}
        self.repository.message.side_effect = [self.user_id, self.assistant_id]
        self.repository.one.side_effect = [self.identity, None]
        result = Mock()
        result.mappings.return_value.all.return_value = [
            {"user_content": "new", "answer": "answer-new"},
            {"user_content": "old", "answer": "answer-old"}]
        result.mappings.return_value.__iter__.return_value = iter([])
        self.connection.execute.return_value = result

    def parameters(self, **values: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {"scope": "unit-scope", "bot": 71, **values}

    async def capture_execute(self, connection: Mock, sql: str, **values: Any) -> None:
        self.assertTrue(self.boundary.active)
        self.assertIs(connection, self.connection)
        self.writes.append((" ".join(sql.split()), values, self.boundary.number))

    async def capture_outbox(self, *args: Any) -> None:
        self.assertTrue(self.boundary.active)
        self.outboxes.append((args, self.boundary.number))

    async def complete(self, messages: list[dict[str, str]]) -> Completion:
        self.assertFalse(self.boundary.active)
        self.assertEqual(self.boundary.events[-1][0], "commit")
        self.assertIn("status='PROCESSING'", self.writes[-1][0])
        return Completion("answer", "model", "provider-id")

    async def send(self, chat: int, content: str, attempts: int) -> Delivery:
        self.assertFalse(self.boundary.active)
        self.assertIn("status='SENDING'", self.writes[-1][0])
        self.assertEqual(self.boundary.events[-1][0], "commit")
        return Delivery("SENT", message_id=91)

    def chunk(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {"id": uuid4(), "content": "answer", "attempts": 0,
                "next_attempt_at": None, "response_kind": "AI", "chunk_number": 0}

    async def test_current_user_history_order_and_atomic_answer(self) -> None:
        await self.worker.process(self.inbox)
        messages = self.ai.reply.await_args.args[0]
        self.assertEqual(messages[2:], [
            {"role": "user", "content": "old"}, {"role": "assistant", "content": "answer-old"},
            {"role": "user", "content": "new"}, {"role": "assistant", "content": "answer-new"},
            {"role": "user", "content": "current"}])
        self.assertEqual(sum(item["content"] == "current" for item in messages), 1)
        statement, parameters = self.connection.execute.await_args.args
        self.assertIsInstance(statement, TextClause)
        sql = " ".join(str(statement).split())
        self.assertIn("i.status='DONE' AND u.inbox_id<>:inbox", sql)
        self.assertIn("ORDER BY u.sequence DESC LIMIT 32", sql)
        self.assertIn("a.reply_to_id=u.id", sql)
        self.assertEqual(parameters, self.parameters(identity=self.inbox["identity_id"], chat=7,
                                                      session=self.session_id, inbox=self.inbox["id"]))
        assistant_call = self.repository.message.await_args_list[1]
        self.assertEqual(assistant_call.args[3:5], ("ASSISTANT", "answer"))
        self.assertEqual(assistant_call.kwargs, {"reply_to": self.user_id, "model": "model", "response_id": "provider-id"})
        self.assertEqual(self.outboxes[0][0][3:], ("AI", ["answer"], self.assistant_id))
        self.assertEqual(self.outboxes[0][1], self.writes[-1][2])
        self.assertIn("status='READY'", self.writes[-1][0])
        self.assertEqual(self.boundary.events, [("begin", 1), ("commit", 1), ("begin", 2), ("commit", 2)])

    async def test_commands_reset_only_new_and_never_call_provider(self) -> None:
        for kind, reset in (("START", False), ("SESSION", False), ("NEW", True)):
            with self.subTest(kind=kind):
                self.repository.one.side_effect = None
                self.repository.one.return_value = self.identity
                self.inbox["kind"] = kind
                self.repository.session.reset_mock()
                await self.worker.process(self.inbox)
                self.repository.session.assert_awaited_once_with(self.connection, self.inbox, reset=reset)
                self.assertEqual(self.outboxes[-1][0][3], "COMMAND")
                self.assertIn(str(self.session_id), self.outboxes[-1][0][4][0])
                self.assertIn("status='READY'", self.writes[-1][0])
        self.ai.reply.assert_not_awaited()
        self.repository.message.assert_not_awaited()

    async def test_retry_reuses_existing_user_and_session(self) -> None:
        self.inbox["session_id"] = self.session_id
        self.inbox["attempts"] = 1
        self.repository.one.side_effect = [self.identity, {"id": self.user_id}]
        self.repository.message.side_effect = None
        self.repository.message.return_value = self.assistant_id
        await self.worker.process(self.inbox)
        self.repository.session.assert_not_awaited()
        self.repository.message.assert_awaited_once()
        self.assertEqual(self.repository.message.await_args.args[3], "ASSISTANT")
        self.assertEqual(self.repository.message.await_args.kwargs["reply_to"], self.user_id)
        lookup = " ".join(self.repository.one.await_args_list[1].args[1].split())
        self.assertIn("inbox_id=:inbox AND role='USER'", lookup)

    async def test_transient_provider_schedules_retry_without_assistant(self) -> None:
        self.ai.reply.side_effect = AIError("AI_RATE_LIMIT", retryable=True, delay=17)
        before = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
        await self.worker.process(self.inbox)
        sql, values, transaction = self.writes[-1]
        self.assertIn("status='RETRY'", sql)
        self.assertEqual(values["code"], "AI_RATE_LIMIT")
        self.assertGreaterEqual(values["next"], before + timedelta(seconds=17))
        self.assertEqual(self.repository.message.await_count, 1)
        self.assertEqual(self.repository.message.await_args.args[3], "USER")
        self.repository.outbox.assert_not_awaited()

    async def test_hard_and_exhausted_errors_create_error_without_assistant(self) -> None:
        for code, retryable, attempts in (("AI_TRANSPORT_UNKNOWN", False, 0),
                                          ("AI_TEMPORARY", True, 2)):
            with self.subTest(code=code):
                self.repository.one.side_effect = [self.identity, {"id": self.user_id}]
                self.inbox["session_id"] = self.session_id
                self.inbox["attempts"] = attempts
                self.ai.reply.side_effect = AIError(code, retryable=retryable)
                self.repository.message.reset_mock()
                await self.worker.process(self.inbox)
                self.repository.message.assert_not_awaited()
                self.assertEqual(self.outboxes[-1][0][3], "ERROR")
                self.assertIn("status='READY'", self.writes[-1][0])
                self.assertEqual(self.writes[-1][1]["code"], code)
                self.assertEqual(self.outboxes[-1][1], self.writes[-1][2])

    async def test_ready_delivery_marks_sending_before_send_and_persists_result(self) -> None:
        self.inbox["status"] = "READY"
        chunk = self.chunk()
        self.repository.one.side_effect = [chunk]
        await self.worker.deliver(self.inbox)
        self.ai.reply.assert_not_awaited()
        self.sender.send.assert_awaited_once_with(7, "answer", 1)
        self.assertEqual(self.writes[-1][1], {"status": "SENT", "code": None,
            "message": 91, "next": None, "retry": 0, "id": chunk["id"]})
        query = " ".join(self.repository.one.await_args.args[1].split())
        self.assertIn("identity_id=:identity AND chat_id=:chat AND inbox_id=:inbox", query)

    async def test_future_retry_waits_outside_transaction_without_busy_query(self) -> None:
        chunk = self.chunk()
        chunk["next_attempt_at"] = datetime.now(timezone.utc) + timedelta(seconds=60)
        self.repository.one.side_effect = [chunk]
        sleeps: list[float] = []

        async def stop_after_sleep(delay: float) -> None:
            self.assertFalse(self.boundary.active)
            sleeps.append(delay)
            self.worker.stopping.set()

        proxy = SimpleNamespace(sleep=stop_after_sleep)
        with patch.object(worker_module, "asyncio", proxy):
            await self.worker.deliver(self.inbox)
        self.assertEqual(sleeps, [1.0])
        self.repository.one.assert_awaited_once()
        self.repository.execute.assert_not_awaited()
        self.sender.send.assert_not_awaited()
        self.ai.reply.assert_not_awaited()

    async def test_unknown_and_fatal_delivery_suppress_tail_without_resending(self) -> None:
        for status in ("UNKNOWN", "FAILED"):
            with self.subTest(status=status):
                self.repository.one.side_effect = [self.chunk(), None, {"id": uuid4()}]
                self.sender.send.side_effect = Delivery(status, "SAFE_CODE")
                self.sender.send.reset_mock()
                await self.worker.deliver(self.inbox)
                tail_sql, tail_values, transaction = self.writes[-1]
                self.assertIn("error_code='PREVIOUS_CHUNK_FAILED'", tail_sql)
                self.assertIn("chunk_number>:number AND status='PENDING'", tail_sql)
                self.assertEqual((tail_values["inbox"], tail_values["kind"], tail_values["number"]),
                                 (self.inbox["id"], "AI", 0))
                await self.worker.deliver(self.inbox)
                self.sender.send.assert_awaited_once()
                self.assertEqual(self.writes[-1][1]["status"], "DELIVERY_FAILED")
        self.ai.reply.assert_not_awaited()

    async def test_all_successful_delivery_finishes_done(self) -> None:
        self.repository.one.side_effect = [None, None]
        await self.worker.deliver(self.inbox)
        self.assertEqual(self.writes[-1][1], {"status": "DONE", "id": self.inbox["id"]})
        self.sender.send.assert_not_awaited()
        self.ai.reply.assert_not_awaited()

    async def test_processing_crash_recovers_error_and_unknown_send_suppresses_tail(self) -> None:
        self.inbox["session_id"] = self.session_id
        result = Mock()
        result.mappings.return_value.__iter__.return_value = iter([self.inbox])
        self.connection.execute.return_value = result
        await self.worker.recover()
        self.assertIn("status='UNKNOWN', error_code='CRASH_DURING_SEND'", self.writes[0][0])
        self.assertIn("status='SENDING'", self.writes[0][0])
        self.assertIn("error_code='PREVIOUS_CHUNK_UNKNOWN'", self.writes[1][0])
        self.assertIn("p.status IN ('UNKNOWN','FAILED')", self.writes[1][0])
        statement, parameters = self.connection.execute.await_args.args
        self.assertIsInstance(statement, TextClause)
        self.assertIn("status='PROCESSING'", str(statement))
        self.assertEqual(parameters, self.parameters())
        self.assertEqual(self.outboxes[0][0][3], "ERROR")
        self.assertIn("error_code='AI_CRASH_UNKNOWN'", self.writes[-1][0])
        self.assertTrue(self.worker.healthy)
        self.assertEqual({item[2] for item in self.writes}, {1})
        self.ai.reply.assert_not_awaited()
        self.sender.send.assert_not_awaited()
        self.repository.message.assert_not_awaited()

import asyncio
import unittest
from contextlib import suppress
from types import SimpleNamespace
from unittest.mock import AsyncMock, Mock, patch

from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncConnection, AsyncEngine
import app.core.database as database_module
from app.core.database import Database, DatabaseSettings, OwnershipLost


class BeginBoundary:
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.events: list[str] = []

    async def __aenter__(self) -> None:
        self.events.append("begin")

    async def __aexit__(self, error_type: object, error: object, traceback: object) -> None:
        self.events.append("rollback" if error_type is not None else "commit")


class DatabaseTests(unittest.IsolatedAsyncioTestCase):
    def setUp(self) -> None:
        self.engine = Mock(spec=AsyncEngine)
        self.connection = Mock(spec=AsyncConnection)
        self.connection.closed = False
        self.connection.invalidated = False
        self.connection.scalar = AsyncMock(side_effect=[True, "0001_telegram"])
        self.connection.commit = AsyncMock()
        self.connection.execute = AsyncMock()
        self.connection.close = AsyncMock()
        self.connection.invalidate = AsyncMock()
        self.begin = BeginBoundary()
        self.connection.begin = Mock(return_value=self.begin)
        self.engine.connect = AsyncMock(return_value=self.connection)
        self.engine.dispose = AsyncMock()
        with patch.object(database_module, "create_async_engine", return_value=self.engine) as factory:
            self.database = Database(DatabaseSettings("postgresql+asyncpg://unit:dummy@localhost/unit"), "scope")
        factory.assert_called_once()
        self.assertFalse(factory.call_args.kwargs["echo"])

    async def test_advisory_lock_denial_never_becomes_owned(self) -> None:
        self.connection.scalar.side_effect = [False]
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(RuntimeError, "Bot sudah dimiliki"):
            await self.database.acquire(71)
        self.assertFalse(self.database.owned)
        self.connection.commit.assert_awaited_once()
        self.connection.begin.assert_not_called()
        statement, parameters = self.connection.scalar.await_args.args
        self.assertIn("pg_try_advisory_lock(:key)", str(statement))
        self.assertIsInstance(parameters["key"], int)
        await self.database.close()
        self.engine.dispose.assert_awaited_once()

    async def test_migration_version_missing_rolls_back_and_closes(self) -> None:
        self.connection.scalar.side_effect = [True, None]
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(RuntimeError, "Migrasi AI belum sesuai"):
            await self.database.acquire(71)
        self.assertEqual(self.begin.events, ["begin", "rollback"])
        await self.database.close()
        self.assertFalse(self.database.owned)
        self.connection.close.assert_awaited_once()
        self.engine.dispose.assert_awaited_once()

    async def test_transaction_commit_rollback_and_ping(self) -> None:
        await self.database.acquire(71)
        async with self.database.transaction() as connection:
            self.assertIs(connection, self.connection)
            self.assertTrue(self.database.lock.locked())
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(RuntimeError, "unit-abort"):
            async with self.database.transaction():
                raise RuntimeError("unit-abort")
        self.assertTrue(await self.database.ping())
        self.assertEqual(self.begin.events, ["begin", "commit", "begin", "commit",
                                            "begin", "rollback", "begin", "commit"])
        self.assertFalse(self.database.lock.locked())
        self.assertEqual(str(self.connection.execute.await_args.args[0]), "SELECT 1")
        await self.database.close()

    async def test_invalidated_owner_never_reconnects(self) -> None:
        await self.database.acquire(71)
        self.connection.invalidated = True
        for attempt in range(2):
            with self.subTest(attempt=attempt), self.assertRaisesRegex(OwnershipLost, "^DB_OWNER_LOST$"):
                await self.database.ping()
        self.assertFalse(self.database.owned)
        self.engine.connect.assert_awaited_once()
        self.connection.execute.assert_not_awaited()
        await self.database.close()

    async def test_invalidation_during_transaction_removes_ownership(self) -> None:
        await self.database.acquire(71)
        async with self.database.transaction():
            self.connection.invalidated = True
        self.assertFalse(self.database.owned)
        with self.assertRaises(OwnershipLost):
            async with self.database.transaction():
                self.fail("Invalid owner yielded a connection")
        self.engine.connect.assert_awaited_once()
        await self.database.close()

    async def test_successful_close_disposes_and_releases_ownership(self) -> None:
        await self.database.acquire(71)
        await self.database.close()
        self.assertFalse(self.database.owned)
        self.connection.close.assert_awaited_once()
        self.connection.invalidate.assert_not_awaited()
        self.engine.dispose.assert_awaited_once()

    async def test_close_failure_timeout_and_invalidate_failure_are_safe(self) -> None:

import asyncio
import unittest
from contextlib import suppress
from types import SimpleNamespace
from unittest.mock import AsyncMock, Mock, patch

from aiogram import Bot, Dispatcher
from aiogram.exceptions import TelegramNetworkError
from aiogram.methods import GetMe
import app.channels.telegram.bot as channel_module
from app.channels.telegram.bot import TelegramChannel, await_owned, start_telegram_channel
from app.channels.telegram.handlers import Intake
from app.chat.worker import Worker
from app.core.database import Database


class ChannelTests(unittest.IsolatedAsyncioTestCase):
    def setUp(self) -> None:
        self.bot = Mock(spec=Bot)
        self.bot.id = 71
        self.bot.session = SimpleNamespace(close=AsyncMock())
        self.bot.get_me = AsyncMock()
        self.bot.get_webhook_info = AsyncMock(return_value=SimpleNamespace(url=""))
        self.database = Mock(spec=Database)
        self.database.owned = True
        self.database.ping = AsyncMock(return_value=True)
        self.database.close = AsyncMock()
        self.database.acquire = AsyncMock()
        self.intake = Mock(spec=Intake)
        self.intake.failed = asyncio.Event()
        self.intake.healthy = True
        self.worker = Mock(spec=Worker)
        self.worker.healthy = True
        self.worker.stopping = asyncio.Event()
        self.worker.run = AsyncMock()
        self.dispatcher = Dispatcher(disable_fsm=True)
        self.channel = TelegramChannel(self.bot, self.dispatcher, self.database, self.intake, self.worker)

    async def finish_task(self, task: asyncio.Task[None]) -> None:
        if not task.done():
            task.cancel()
        with suppress(asyncio.CancelledError):
            await task

    async def test_await_owned_cancellation_waits_for_cleanup(self) -> None:
        entered, release, finished = asyncio.Event(), asyncio.Event(), asyncio.Event()

        async def cleanup() -> None:
            entered.set()
            await release.wait()
            finished.set()

        owned = asyncio.create_task(cleanup())
        caller = asyncio.create_task(await_owned(owned))
        try:
            await asyncio.wait_for(entered.wait(), 1)
            caller.cancel()
            await asyncio.sleep(0)
            self.assertFalse(caller.done())
            self.assertFalse(owned.cancelled())
            release.set()
            with self.assertRaises(asyncio.CancelledError):
                await asyncio.wait_for(caller, 1)
            self.assertTrue(finished.is_set())
        finally:
            release.set()
            await self.finish_task(caller)
            await self.finish_task(owned)

    async def test_native_dispatcher_stop_awaits_polling_child_finally(self) -> None:
        entered, child_closed = asyncio.Event(), asyncio.Event()

        async def polling_child(**kwargs: object) -> None:
            self.assertIs(kwargs["bot"], self.bot)
            self.assertFalse(kwargs["handle_as_tasks"])
            entered.set()
            try:
                await asyncio.Event().wait()
            finally:
                child_closed.set()

        # Only the SDK network polling child is replaced. Real start_polling,
        # stop_polling, startup observers, running lock and task teardown run.
        with patch.object(self.dispatcher, "_polling", side_effect=polling_child):
            runner = asyncio.create_task(self.channel.run_poller())
            self.channel.polling_task = runner
            try:
                await asyncio.wait_for(entered.wait(), 1)
                self.assertTrue(self.channel.polling_started.is_set())
                await asyncio.wait_for(self.channel.stop_poller(), 1)
                self.assertTrue(child_closed.is_set())
                self.assertTrue(runner.done())
                self.assertTrue(self.channel.polling_finished.is_set())
                self.bot.session.close.assert_not_awaited()
            finally:
                await self.finish_task(runner)
                if self.channel.poller_stop_task is not None:
                    await self.finish_task(self.channel.poller_stop_task)

    async def test_stop_before_startup_waits_for_observation(self) -> None:
        release, entered = asyncio.Event(), asyncio.Event()
        dispatcher = Mock(spec=Dispatcher)
        dispatcher.startup = SimpleNamespace(register=Mock())
        dispatcher.stop_polling = AsyncMock(side_effect=release.set)
        channel = TelegramChannel(self.bot, dispatcher, self.database, self.intake, self.worker)

        async def runner_body() -> None:
            entered.set()
            await release.wait()
            channel.polling_finished.set()

        runner = asyncio.create_task(runner_body())
        channel.polling_task = runner
        stop = asyncio.create_task(channel.stop_poller())
        try:
            await asyncio.wait_for(entered.wait(), 1)
            await asyncio.sleep(0)
            dispatcher.stop_polling.assert_not_awaited()
            self.assertFalse(runner.cancelled())
            await channel.observe_startup(self.bot)
            await asyncio.wait_for(stop, 1)
            dispatcher.stop_polling.assert_awaited_once()
        finally:
            release.set()
            await self.finish_task(stop)
            await self.finish_task(runner)
            if channel.poller_stop_task is not None:
                await self.finish_task(channel.poller_stop_task)

    async def test_finished_and_failed_runner_stop_without_sdk_stop(self) -> None:
        for failed in (False, True):
            with self.subTest(failed=failed):
                async def finished_runner() -> None:
                    if failed:
                        raise RuntimeError("unit-failure")

                runner = asyncio.create_task(finished_runner())
                await asyncio.wait({runner}, timeout=1)
                channel = TelegramChannel(self.bot, self.dispatcher, self.database, self.intake, self.worker)
                channel.polling_task = runner
                with patch.object(self.dispatcher, "stop_polling", new=AsyncMock()) as sdk_stop:
                    await asyncio.wait_for(channel.stop_poller(), 1)
                    sdk_stop.assert_not_awaited()
                self.assertTrue(runner.done())
                if channel.poller_stop_task is not None:
                    await channel.poller_stop_task

    async def test_repeated_stop_shares_cleanup_and_cancelled_worker_still_closes(self) -> None:
        async def waiting_worker() -> None:
            await asyncio.Event().wait()

        task = asyncio.create_task(waiting_worker())
        self.channel.worker_task = task
        task.cancel()
        with suppress(asyncio.CancelledError):
            await task
        try:
            await asyncio.wait_for(asyncio.gather(self.channel.stop(), self.channel.stop()), 1)
            cleanup = self.channel.cleanup_task
            await self.channel.stop()
            self.assertIs(self.channel.cleanup_task, cleanup)
            self.assertTrue(self.worker.stopping.is_set())
            self.bot.session.close.assert_awaited_once()
            self.database.close.assert_awaited_once()
        finally:
            await self.finish_task(task)
            if self.channel.cleanup_task is not None:
                await self.finish_task(self.channel.cleanup_task)
            if self.channel.poller_stop_task is not None:
                await self.finish_task(self.channel.poller_stop_task)

    async def test_readiness_requires_live_healthy_owned_tasks(self) -> None:
        async def waiting() -> None:
            await asyncio.Event().wait()

        tasks = [asyncio.create_task(waiting()) for _ in range(3)]
        self.channel.polling_task, self.channel.worker_task, self.channel.supervisor_task = tasks
        self.channel.polling_started.set()
        try:
            self.assertTrue(await self.channel.ready())
            for target, attribute in ((self.channel, "closing"), (self.channel, "failed"),
                                      (self.database, "owned"), (self.intake, "healthy"), (self.worker, "healthy")):
                original = getattr(target, attribute)
                setattr(target, attribute, not original)
                self.assertFalse(await self.channel.ready())
                setattr(target, attribute, original)
            self.database.ping.side_effect = asyncio.TimeoutError()
            self.assertFalse(await self.channel.ready())
            self.database.ping.side_effect = None
            await self.finish_task(tasks[0])
            self.assertFalse(await self.channel.ready())
        finally:
            for task in tasks:
                await self.finish_task(task)

    async def test_supervised_worker_failure_stops_poller(self) -> None:
        polling_release = asyncio.Event()

        async def polling() -> None:
            await polling_release.wait()

        async def failed_worker() -> None:
            raise RuntimeError("dummy-secret")

        async def stop_poller() -> None:
            polling_release.set()

        polling_task = asyncio.create_task(polling())
        worker_task = asyncio.create_task(failed_worker())
        self.channel.polling_task = polling_task
        self.channel.worker_task = worker_task
        try:
            with patch.object(self.channel, "stop_poller", new=AsyncMock(side_effect=stop_poller)) as stop:
                with self.assertLogs(channel_module.logger, level="ERROR") as logs:
                    await asyncio.wait_for(self.channel.supervise(), 1)
                self.assertTrue(self.channel.failed)
                stop.assert_awaited_once()
                self.assertNotIn("dummy-secret", " ".join(logs.output))
        finally:
            polling_release.set()
            await self.finish_task(polling_task)
            with suppress(RuntimeError):
                await self.finish_task(worker_task)

    async def test_startup_webhook_rejection_and_sdk_failure_close_fake_resources(self) -> None:
        settings = SimpleNamespace(telegram=SimpleNamespace(token="dummy-token", service_scope="unit"),
                                   database=SimpleNamespace(url="dummy-url"))
        for mode in ("webhook", "network"):
            with self.subTest(mode=mode):
                self.bot.session.close.reset_mock()
                self.database.close.reset_mock()
                self.bot.get_me.side_effect = None
                self.bot.get_webhook_info.return_value = SimpleNamespace(url="https://invalid.example/hook")
                if mode == "network":
                    self.bot.get_me.side_effect = TelegramNetworkError(GetMe(), "dummy-secret")
                with patch.object(channel_module, "Bot", return_value=self.bot), patch.object(
                    channel_module, "Database", return_value=self.database):
                    with self.assertRaises(RuntimeError) as caught:
                        await asyncio.wait_for(start_telegram_channel(settings, Mock()), 1)
                self.assertNotIn("dummy-secret", str(caught.exception))
                self.database.acquire.assert_not_awaited()
                self.bot.session.close.assert_awaited_once()
                self.database.close.assert_awaited_once()

    async def test_startup_cancellation_closes_fake_resources_before_propagation(self) -> None:
        entered = asyncio.Event()
        settings = SimpleNamespace(telegram=SimpleNamespace(token="dummy-token", service_scope="unit"),
                                   database=SimpleNamespace(url="dummy-url"))

        async def blocked_get_me() -> None:
            entered.set()
            await asyncio.Event().wait()

        self.bot.get_me.side_effect = blocked_get_me
        with patch.object(channel_module, "Bot", return_value=self.bot), patch.object(
            channel_module, "Database", return_value=self.database):
            task = asyncio.create_task(start_telegram_channel(settings, Mock()))
            try:
                await asyncio.wait_for(entered.wait(), 1)
                task.cancel()
                with self.assertRaises(asyncio.CancelledError):
                    await asyncio.wait_for(task, 1)
                self.bot.session.close.assert_awaited_once()
                self.database.close.assert_awaited_once()
            finally:
                await self.finish_task(task)
